posts.text: What a pivot from earlier B2C model to B2B. I remember Bhavish said they are confident about B2C model as it has superior margins and they have cracked the model, etc. It seems that he understood the complexities involved with B2C model, as Ola is struggling for several quarters to scale the logistics, supply chain, service infra. With B2B most of these will be taken care by the dealer. It will be in dealers interest too to maintain right level of inventories, spare parts, servicing staff, etc. I believe the problems Ola is facing until now has more to do with their lack of service infrastruct…

posts.text: Just sharing an observation. Since the March 2026 when deliveries bounced back, there is a continuous accumulation going on. Last month it was particularly high, mutual funds holding in Ola stands at 8.5% as of June 2026. Notable is to also see a consistent love of Motilal Oswal fund house’s love for Ola . Looks like either mutual funds are taking contrarian bet or they know something that broader market may not know or can’t see. Discl: Invested, not a recommendation to buy or sell.
